property.name: git.commit.message.full
property.value:
refactor(architecture): move decision reports to composition (#628 D1) (#1055)
* refactor(hypotheses): give relations lifecycle and HTTP authority
Resolve legacy repository selections through a workspace-owned port, preserving explicit repository identity and rejecting workspace provenance mismatches before review. Keep all hypothesis storage access behind workspace APIs, preserve HTTP/transaction contracts, retain critical coverage budgets and ratchet removed dependencies.
Part of #628 and C2 of #1043.
* refactor(architecture): move decision report orchestration to composition (#628)
* test(relations): retain coverage and remove sensitive validation diagnostics
* test(architecture): select report guard and update ownership docs
